days.title: Northern Forests and Waters
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Macchia Lucchese
stops.detail: The Macchia Lucchese is the wooded strip to the north, enclosed between Viareggio, Torre del Lago Puccini and the coast.

stops.name: Tenuta di Migliarino
stops.detail: In the Migliarino estate there are the remains of what was the headquarters of the 10th MAS Flotilla of the Royal Navy during WWII.

days.title: Coastal Estates and Information
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Centro Visite
stops.detail: For guided tours it is possible to contact the Visitor Centre every day and enter with a guide.

stops.name: La Sterpaia
stops.detail: The former Presidential Estate of San Rossore is open to the public every day in the area between Cascine Vecchie and La Sterpaia.

stops.name: Tenuta di Tombolo
stops.detail: Inside the area there is also the CISAM (in which the first Italian nuclear reactor "Galileo Galilei" was installed) and, in the Tombolo Estate, the US Army base of Camp Darby.

days.title: Southern Estates and Marine Shallows
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tenuta di Coltano
stops.detail: The Macchia Lucchese, Lake Massaciuccoli, the Coltano Estate and part of the Migliarino and Tombolo estates can be visited freely.

stops.name: Secche della Meloria
stops.detail: The Meloria shoals complete the management areas of the park, an important system of shallows with two outcropping rocks and seabeds of important naturalistic value.
